units.source_text: 那本画册收入了保罗·克利、亨利·马蒂斯、马克·夏加尔等人的画，以及现代抽象派的画。

en.t: That album included paintings by Paul Klee, Henri Matisse, Marc Chagall, and others, as well as works of modern abstract art.

units.source_text: 千重子心想，这些画说不定能唤起新的感觉，所以为父亲买了下来。

en.t: Chieko thought that these pictures might awaken a new sensibility, so she bought the album for her father.
